about: Per-character class title shown under the name on the status panel, one per Disgaea RPG base character (the pack folders carry the base id in mod.json source_import.source.row.base_id). JP = JP client masters/characterclassname (m_character_id, rarity = character.base_rare). EN is the documented English when a community or official source names this exact title (en_kind "community", cited in en_source with page URL, revision, author and quoted name); otherwise it is a labelled provisional literal translation (en_kind "provisional") that names the reason. en_kind "official" is reserved for a title whose source is the archived Global master alone; no row uses it while Sean's source decision is open (DRPGTITLE2). Latin slots (title_EN/FR) get EN, the CJK slots (title_JP/CHN/KOR) keep the JP source spelling (nativeimports._set_latin convention). DRPGTITLE2 rework 2026-11-19: the community citation is the Disgaea RPG Wiki (Fandom) page, whose rendered star-rarity block shows the title the character prints at that rarity; the archived Global master is cited beside it as corroboration where the two agree. A title counts only when the JP string we ship is the same title the column carries (verbatim match) or, for the two characters whose JP character row has no class-name columns, when the wiki assigns the name to the same rarity slot the pack prints. Where the two documented names disagree the title stays provisional (ids 55 and 20011).
source: Disgaea Source/Disgaea RPG JP (Android) masters/characterclassname + masters/character (decoded by the drpg-tables lane, Research/source-packs/drpg/TABLES-REPORT.md). Documented English: the Disgaea RPG Wiki (Fandom), character pages and Template:Enum/JP/Titles (see community_source). Corroboration: the archived extract of the Disgaea RPG Global client masters/character (sha256 4ef77b532cd3846351bdc596bf7b04d4167edf08650cec6d72a91d1b5baa0cac, 489 rows, every id also in JP), used only where it agrees with the community page and pending Sean's decision on that source (see official_source). DRPGTITLE2.

official_source.file: Disgaea RPG Global client masters/character (archived extract, 489 rows)
official_source.provenance: extracted from the Global client, which is not kept in Disgaea Source/ (Sean, 2026-11-02: JP supersedes it); hash recorded in Research/Forge/j9-rpg-evidence.md and re-checked 2026-11-18. Corroboration only: Sean's decision on using it as English localization evidence is open (card t_ba5e03b0, default keep provisional), so no row is sourced from it alone.
official_source.pairing: by character id (all 489 Global ids exist in JP) and class-name column: characterclassname rarity r equals character.class_name_(r-1) of the same id (checked on 321 rows with both tables filled, 270 exact). Every community row in this table also names the same word in the Global row; ids 55 and 20011 disagree and stay provisional.
